blocks.content: Support layer (354 TS lines, plus the stylesheets app.css (~2.8k, incl. the v4.4 settings-modal and project-menu rules) and themes.css (~240)). api.ts is the typed facade over window.xtrac (one method per IPC channel, ~40 of them). types.ts mirrors host shapes (Settings, ChatRecord, Project, Task, StorageUsage…) and re-exports the shared timeline model. lib/format.ts has the markdown sanitizer — raw HTML escaped, links restricted to credential-free http(s), and link labels routed through parseInline/escaping so untrusted label text can never inject markup (2026-10 fix) — plus byte/time formatting and basename. main.tsx mounts React inside an app-level ErrorBoundary (a malformed restored chat record degrades to a recoverable message instead of crash-looping the app), and the rules editor surfaces IPC errors instead of failing silently (2026-10). index.html carries the connect-src 'none' CSP, now also pinning form-action 'none' and base-uri 'none' (2026-10).
useTheme persists dark/light in localStorage and sets data-theme; useAppearance (P4) applies the accent preset as a --accent custom property plus data-reduce-motion, persisting both to settings.json.
Every channel the renderer may call, typed end-to-end.
Escape-first markdown with sanitizer pass — model output is untrusted.
